package rulefixtures

import (
	"fmt"
	"regexp"
)

// scenario for go_perf_layer_string_handling_regexp_compile_in_request_path: Layer: String handling. Flag regexp.Compile or MustCompile inside handlers, loops, or repeated functions.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: contextual.
func scenario596Positive(pattern string, inputs []string) []bool {
	results := make([]bool, len(inputs))
	for i, in := range inputs {
		re, err := regexp.Compile(pattern)
		if err != nil {
			fmt.Printf("bad pattern: %v\n", err)
			continue
		}
		results[i] = re.MatchString(in)
	}
	return results
}
